spec.title: Asking for directions
spec.setting: A busy street corner in Causeway Bay. You're lost.

character.name: Ah Ming
character.role: a friendly local in a hurry
character.speech_style: short directions, uses 呢度 and 嗰度

spec.user_role: a visitor looking for the MTR station
spec.goal: Find out how to get to the MTR station and how long it takes to walk.
spec.opener_hint: Ah Ming notices you looking at your phone and asks if you're lost.
